Warning: Make sure before buying from Chewy that are shipping the order from the same warehouse because they charged me for total order when I placed them when it was shipped they were going to charge me for both items separately,  because it came from two different places, and asked my bank and I if I got charged for other thing two separately.   They don't seem to care if they tie up extra $53.86 in my bank account that I can't use for anything else, until the charge falls off, or if I was going to use it to buy pet food or anything else.   I talk to multiple  people on the phone and email , they feel like what they did and their explanation  is justified and normal.   No it not.   They need get their billing straightened out not charge twice.   Money doesn't grow on trees I use a debit card and it comes out immediately but could take up to 3 months by the bank to give back that ridiculous.

review_title: I have always held Chewy in high…
review_text: I have always held Chewy in high regard. Ordered my cat litter and a few other things from them. If I screwed up an order, they said to keep it and donate to a worthy cause, refunding my money. The last 2 orders were very different. I wanted Revolution for both my dogs and cats as they have ear mites. They said they sent it but somehow the order got lost. I have called them 5 times over the past 2 weeks trying to get my order sent. When I looked at my account tonight, it said awaiting authorization from the vet. My vet authorized the order I never received 2 weeks ago! Sounds like no one followed through. When I contacted customer service yesterday they said it was supposed to be sent out today. The rep said the pharmacist will give me a call tomorrow. As well, carprophen is almost impossible to find in stock, the flavored variety. Carprofen was finally in stock and I received my order in a timely manner.

review_title: Please add Senior Taste of the Wild
review_text: I always order from Chewy. They are fast and usually have what I need. I was hoping to just submit a question or feedback but I could only leave a review. I was disappointed to see a coupon for Senior Taste of the Wild on Google but then it turns out, they do not offer Senior with this brand. It's been a struggle trying to find the right food for my girl because I just read a lot about grain free foods are causing heart problems so I wanted to switch. I finally found one I felt comfortable purchasing and got excited by the coupon, and then I get to the site and they don't have senior.  I'm hoping by this, maybe you guys will add Senior Taste of the Wild to the mix:)

review_title: chewy I love your company and is useful…
review_text: chewy I love your company and is useful in our home but sadly we have to part ways due to   not giving me shipping options. you only ship via FedEx and FedEx consistently looses my packages. I'm glad you were able to correct my last order delivered to wrong address, but I have decided to use companies with reliable shipping.

review_title: Great verity !

review_title: Pet service great, not so with their politics.
review_text: I have been purchasing my pet food, dogs, cat, birds for some time now and think their service is great. Don't agree with their politics though.

review_title: I was amazed by the quality customer…
review_text: I was amazed by the quality customer service experience I had with Chewy. I wrote a review of a product I found inadequate I purchased from them. I received an email making things right just based on my review. I’d like to give special acknowledgment to Chelsea G. who reacted to my review and made sure I was satisfied with my experience with Chewy. I would certainly recommend Chewy for all your pet needs! Keep up the good work!!

review_title: My first experience with chewy customer…
review_text: My first experience with chewy customer service was great! I have a shih tzu puppy who is picky and bought some food that she ate a serving or two mixed with her previous food no problem then wouldn't touch it. They gave my money back then told me to donate to an animal shelter of my choice.

review_title: I love their selection
review_text: I love their selection. The orders come very quick. I can still get litter and food at the store for half the  price of Chewy, but that is the only negative. For most everything else, I willborder from Chewy. I ordered eye wash, ear wash, mouth cleaner and brushes. Very happy.

review_title: I always order from chewy
review_text: I always order from chewy, and they have great customer service, and replace any items that are damaged or if your pet doesn’t like something. I just don’t like the way they package items into boxes though because they’ll put a 50 pound bag of dog food in the same box with canned cat or dog food then the canned food arrives dented, and very damaged. So I always order those items separately now. But other than that they are an amazing company with good prices, and I’ll always order from them

review_title: Love the site navigation and ordering…
review_text: Love the site navigation and ordering online. Orders always come on time and correct. Great return policy for any reason, and they also pay shipping. Occasionally some of my items are out of stock, which is the only negative I have experienced.

review_title: Some Brands Great! Others, Not!
review_text: I first started buying cat food through Chewy because of the pandemic. In the beginning, I had issues with the canned cat food because I was getting defective cans. The oils had separated from the food or the cans were severely dented (and clearly not from shipping). My cats would not eat food from the defective cans. (I have no idea how they could tell the cans were dented. Perhaps, they were just old.) It turned out that these cans were really coming from the manufacturer. I tried different brands until I found ones that didn't sell their defective cans through Chewy. The canned cat food brands I have been buying are Tiny Tiger (pates) and Almo Nature. I mix food from the two brands together. My cats love it, and I don't have to shop in a store to get it!

review_title: I ordered 32 in Ultimate SmartCat cat…
review_text: I ordered 32 in Ultimate SmartCat cat scratcher. Immediately when it began to be in transit in my city, it stopped. The next day I told Chewy what happened and a  representative reported she would order a replacement. That has been in the works of shipping for about a week, again it got in my town today and it stopped updating. I called them again today and the replacement order was never actually put through because it was unavailable.. I don’t think I would trust business with this site ever again. Only am giving 2 stars because they are refunding me the money for this, but this has brought me so much emotional distress UPDATE: the orig package finally came today. I’m happy I’m pleased, I’m sorry for a bad review postal is not on them and I would still consider having future purchases from them!

review_title: Excellent customer service
review_text: You know that Marc Anthony Quote “If you do what you love, you'll never work a day in your life”? I believe the staff at Chewy lives by that. Whenever I spoke to anyone about the flea pills we ordered for our Lhasa Apso Sadie, they were always so cheerful and patiently answered my questions. Fast forward to last week when I canceled our auto-ship because our Sadie girl died of old age. I got two emails, one from Ashley and another from Christina T. They were both so heartwarming to read. One condolence email I get, but TWO!? It didn’t end there. A few days later we received a beautiful bouquet of flowers with a lovely note from Ashley. The customer service at Chewy is exemplary. I believe they truly live by their mission statement “We view pets (and pet parents) as family and are obsessed with meeting their needs and exceeding customer expectations through every interaction.” I didn’t know that was their mission statement until now, so that makes every interaction that much sweeter. Thank you, Ashley and Christina T, and the entire team at Chewy. You obviously love what you do.

review_title: Basically Amazon for pets
review_text: Basically Amazon for pets. Only annoying thing is the $5 shipping charge for under $50 packages. Sometimes I just don’t need more stuff ya know.

review_title: Great and helpful site
review_text: Especially during a pandemic, Chewy has been a lifesaver for our pet.  Millie is on a prescription diet, and Chewy works with the veterinarian to review her prescription every time we order.  They deliver promptly and dependably.  Their prices are not always the best, but they are often competitive.

review_title: Great customer service
review_text: Great customer service. An item arrived broken and it took (no exaggeration) 2 whole minutes on the phone with them before a replacement was sent!

review_title: Flea away chewable tablets
review_text: Just bought Flea away. Tablets are larger than normal but crush easily. I crush 1 tablet in teaspoon of PB. Dogs love it and seems to be working.  Love the fact it's made in USA!!

review_title: I love Chewy, except for one thing
review_text: I love Chewy.  I get litter and other things for my cats from them.  It's a great company with excellent customer service.  They even gave me a full refund for a product I bought that I didn't like, and suggested that I donate the product to someone else, which I did.  I was pretty amazed by that. I would give them five stars except for one thing:  when they pack the boxes of cat litter, they're almost always packed lying on their sides, rather than standing up in the packing carton.  Every single one that's shipped on its side splits a little at the top where the box handle is and litter spills out.  Boxes shipped standing up don't do that.  Chewy wraps each litter box in plastic, so when the shipment arrives, the spilled litter is contained but when I remove the plastic wrap, it goes everywhere and is wasted.  I've contacted them at least twice to ask them to consider shipping the boxes upright (I've gotten them that way, so I know it's possible), but to no avail.  I just unwrapped 20 boxes of litter today, and swept up probably two pounds of litter that is just wasted.  Every single one had split a little. Otherwise, wonderful company.  Even though I'm frustrated with this one problem, I will continue to buy from them.

review_title: Why the massive price increase?
review_text: Price increased 20% overnight on the chewy.com brand dry cat food we buy monthly.  Not happy about that. Also, chewy.com won't allow you to mention the word "price" when leaving a review on there site.  Hmmmm, I wonder why?

review_title: Love chewy
review_text: Love chewy! Most the time I can find cheaper prices than in store. The only down fall and reason for 4 stars is because with my auto ship the prices change from month to month- so when I set it up I was getting my dog food for around $25 but then my auto ship for the next month was almost $40. A little more transparency prior to signing up for auto pay would be great. Their customer service is amazing though and adjusted the price for me the first time it happened.

review_title: I had just bought n received a battery…
review_text: I had just bought n received a battery operated butterfly toy for my 11 week old kitten. She tore it up! Ugh i just wish they would make them more durable for kittens. Now what do i do with this toy?

review_title: Friendly customer support team
review_text: Friendly customer support team. Do not change anything please.

review_title: I am shocked by some of the reviews…
review_text: I am shocked by some of the reviews about customer service. I guess there is always one bad apple. I rarely write reviews and Chewy is amazing and I wanted to let you know you can trust your pet in their hands.

review_title: Great service, just need to use UPS instead.
review_text: Excellent! Quality products, and a great review section to insure a good purchases. Always ships ontime on their end. Only negative is they use FedEx for shipping and they're completely unreliable.

review_title: Everything from exchanges to returns…
review_text: Everything from exchanges to returns have been handled professionally.

review_title: Chewy is fantastic
review_text: Chewy is fantastic. I've been using autoship for years. Packaging is much better than Petco, and the pricing is competitive. They also often have things in stock that Petco or other pet places don't. It is easy to skip shipments, which I do if I have enough already. This month I didn't realize I was super low on wet food for my cat. I was figuring I would have to go to Petco to buy a couple cans until the box arrived, but it came the next day. I didn't even choose quick shipping or do anything different. Thanks, Chewy!

review_title: Chewy, you hired well!
review_text: I just wanted to say how helpful the customer service member was that I talked to.  Adane was polite, patient, and knowledgeable.  He helped me figure out that there was a second account opened, which was impacting my ability to see all of my orders.  He helped me to consolidate the accounts and close the secondary one.  His customer service skills were excellent and much appreciated by me.

review_title: CHEWY HAS GONE ABOVE BEING BUSINESS KIND
review_text: Chewy has always been helpful and kind over the years we’ve been using their services. They even sent us a beautiful memorial stone for our 13 year old Dachshund after I changed the autoship profile to memorialize Darling. Wish I was able to leave a picture with my review. Thank you Chewy for your kindness!

review_title: I would give 10 stars
review_text: I would give 10 stars! I had a auto shipment come in that I forgot to cancel. It was nearly $100, and I can't afford losing money like that. In a chat with Lindsey, who was very proficient and personable, she listened to my reasons for not being able to use that product again, and she understood. She refunded the order. Quick and painless. I'll always buy from them now. Great job, Lindsey!

review_title: Memorial Stone…
review_text: I've been a customer for years and always received great service.  But recently my 15 y/o cat died and so I updated my profile page to delete his name.  Today I received in the mail a surprise package from Chewy.  In it was a beautiful memorial stone with his name and flowers hand-painted, in a velvet drawstring bag and sympathy card.  Such a thoughtful gift and unexpected.  They are a special group of people and business that really does care about their customers and the much-loved animal companions.

review_title: Unbeatable customer service
review_text: I have been using Chewy‘s auto-ship for several years and they’ve always been very quick to ship and have a great customer service when it comes to correcting any issues. Recently, I lost my 18-year-old cat and I was completely blown away by their support during this time. They refunded a pretty big portion of my recent orders along with sending a nice message. Great customer service goes a long way! I’ll be a customer for life.

review_title: Pharmacy staff went above and beyond…
review_text: I had ordered two prescriptions via the Chewy pharmacy, and my new equine vet clinic was being negligent about getting the scrips in. Days went by, and the Chewy pharmacy techs were very good about following up with the clinic to see about where those scrips were. They also changed the delivery address to correspond to my boarding farm so the order would get to the horse sooner. They did their job very well and it was much appreciated after getting bad customer service from the clinic.

review_title: Compassionate customer service
review_text: My cat died yesterday. I called Chewy to cancel auto refills on expensive medications and food. They made it very easy and even refunded money for items that had already been shipped. Their staff were kind to me when I was having a terrible day.  I am grateful for their compassion.

review_title: They are amazing, great prices,too.
review_text: They are amazing. My pet passed away the day i received my auto ship.  I contacted them to return the items and they were so empathetic.  They gave me a complete refund and asked me to donate the items. I feel so appreciative that they stepped up and did that

review_title: I am 100% satisfied with the chewy…
review_text: I am 100% satisfied with the chewy products and Customer they go above and beyond to make sure that you are pleased with your purchase they’ve got quick very quick shipping on dog food sometimes the very next day the majority of the time and just recently I had lost my dog in 15 years, they credited me for the last bag of dog food that I had purchased for her and not only that they actually sent flowers to my home and a sympathy card. I thought that was super special and it was actually personal had her name on it and everything so yes 100% recommend chewy to anybody with their dog cat. Any really kind of animal needs thank you for being a honest and carrying company.

review_title: Chewy loves our pets
review_text: My pet passed away in February 2026. I couldn’t find where to stop my auto ship. So I called them. They were very helpful to get my auto ship stopped and were very kind regarding their condolences with the loss of my dog. I had lost one unexpectedly in June 2025 and now the passing of my 16 1/2 year-old dog.  They ended up sending me a bouquet of flowers, which were absolutely beautiful. And I was shocked that they lasted almost 3 weeks. Then today I get the most beautiful painted canvas picture of my girl. I was so shocked. Chewy has been top notch and went over and beyond in showing how much they really care about the loss of my pet.

review_title: A company who cares
review_text: Chewy is an awesome company. They care about their customers. Wednesday I had to put my Pixie down. I called chewy and asked them if I could return the medication unopened that was delivered the week before. Unfortunately due to laws they cannot take the returns, but did credit me back the money. Today they just delivered soe flowers in memory of Pixie. When I finally get another dog, I will definitely continue to order from chewy.

review_title: Chewy Loves Fur Babies & Family
review_text: I've been using chewy off and on for 10+ years. From changing orders, to transferring orders, to prescription food. Any situation I have had, has been resolved quickly and with Great professionalism.  This week our Beloved dog Murphy passed away. I went on my account, canceled his auto ships and needed to return two full cases of his prescription food. The lady I spoke with was very sweet. She returned both cases of food, then proceeded to tell me I could just donate them. So I donated to a non-profit. Today, I got a knock on my door. When I opened it, I was greeted with a bouquet of flowers and a card. I almost cried!!! It was from Natalia and our Chewy team!!! I just want them to know how thankful I am for their continued service and Love of All Animals! Thank you Dan & Shari Flynn

review_title: Great Pet Care
review_text: Chewy is easy to use and provides great customer service. They have a wide enough selection that most items for my animals are always readily available. Their automated shipping and their return process are simple.

review_title: Chewy customer service has always been…
review_text: Their customer service has always been over the top! Ive had issues with not getting my deliveries and they have gone above and beyond by resending my order again of the same product for free. I thought I was paying more for my products but when comparing eith my l9cal pet store. I am very satified because i am paying the same price and it gets delivered.  Also, I was on a call placing an order and  I mentioned that I've been sick for several weeks, about a week later I received a package in the mail. Very curious to see what it was as I had not ordered anything, upon opening the box it was from Chewy. The representative had sent me a very nice get well card, a Chewy mug, along with tea packages and honey sticks for my flu. That's above and beyond great customer service I will always refer people to shop with  Chewy.

review_title: The Best Company
review_text: The Best Company to deal with. Friendly, efficient and excellent customer service. Chewy you have won my heart. 💜 Thank you for being there for our pets!

review_title: Big Companies Can Have a Heart
review_text: We recently lost one of our beloved cats, Jerry, to cancer. It was very sudden and unexpected. Memories of our beautiful orange boy's crazy adventures are just now starting to bring smiles and laughter, and often still tears. Earlier this week I was cleaning up some online accounts including updating our pet profiles with Chewy. I was offered the option to post a memorial for Jerry and although I elected not to, it made the 'moving on' process a little easier. So imagine my complete surprise, when I opened my door today to receive a beautiful flower arrangement from, Chewy.com with condolences. What a gesture. Thank you Chewy for showing that big companies can show some heart. Thank you for recognizing that our family is more than just another order. Sincerely, Dedicated Customer & Cat-mom in TN

review_title: Very Thoughtful Company
review_text: I have used Chewy for a few years for my dogs medicine and toothpaste. After she went to heaven I called them to stop my auto ships.  Two weeks later I received a box in the mail from them. Inside was a sympathy card signed by Meagan and team along with a hand painted rock with my dogs name on it. So sweet and thoughtful. ♥️🙏🏻

review_title: Thanking Chewy for their kind heart
review_text: I just want to commend Chewy for their kind heart.  I recently called in a panic because I had ordered some Kidney diet dog food for my Dad's dog that was ailing.  I think I ordered on a Friday or Saturday.  On Monday morning, I got a call that my Dad was on the way to have his dog, Cooper, put down because he was suffering.  I asked the customer service rep to please cancel the dog food order because I didn't want it showing up after the fact and making it even harder for my elderly Dad.  She was an absolute angel and so caring!  A week or two later, my Dad received a beautiful painted rock with Cooper's name on it in the mail.  This special touch was so appreciated!

review_title: I really recommend to everyone to order…
review_text: I really recommend to everyone to order with Chewy . Excellent service , fast delivery .

review_title: Chewy went above and beyond during one…
review_text: Chewy went above and beyond during one of the hardest moments for our family. We received a beautiful memorial stone for our beloved Melvin, and the care behind it was truly touching. In a time of grief, their kindness brought real comfort. It’s rare to find a company that shows this level of compassion, and we’re genuinely grateful for the thoughtfulness they showed us.

review_title: UTI  FOOD FOR US!!!
review_text: While I would love to save money by buying cheap cat food, you know, the stuff that's mostly corn, probably 50# for 3$, but alas, I love my cats too much.  They are prone to UTIs so I buy UTI food.  Duh... Anyway, I ordered the IAMS UTI food for my shelter, yes, they're all on it, and was thrilled with the price, not to mention the delivery time. This is my "go to" place for their food, although if Chewy is looking for cat models I have many to choose from, and they will work for food.   Thank you for being there for us Chewy!

review_title: Ordered Seresto collars for my dogs and…
review_text: Ordered Seresto collars for my dogs and they arrive 18 hours later!  Not sure how they did that but it was appreciated!   We have always had reliable service with Chewy but this was impressive!

review_title: Always great
review_text: Always great. Amazing support. Any time I've encountered an issue with an order, they've always corrected it right away. Way better prices than we find at local pharmacies for meds.

review_title: I’ve used chewy for a lot
review_text: I’ve used chewy for pet foods, toys, cat trees, litter, dog toys and medicine. They’ve always been on time with delivery and accurate packaging. Some things are a little more expensive but they seem to take good care of everything and work efficiently with my vets office

review_title: A moment to highlight this company
review_text: I want to take a moment to highlight this company because they truly deserve it. I absolutely love what Chewy does—their fast and reliable shipping, the care they put into every package, and their exceptional customer service. It’s rare to find a company that delivers such a consistently outstanding experience from start to finish. Every interaction feels thoughtful and professional, and you can tell they genuinely care about their customers. That level of trust is hard to earn, and Chewy has definitely earned mine. I will continue choosing them without hesitation and confidently recommend them to anyone looking for quality, reliability, and top-tier service. Truly exceptional!

review_title: Been a customer for years
review_text: Been a customer for years, recently lost our Lab of 13 years, Chewy sent us a momento commemorating our girl. Thank you, Chewy

review_title: 5 stars, hands down
review_text: We have been using chewy for about 5 or 6 years, and we LOVE them. They have competitive prices, a great autoship discount, and incredible customer service and responsiveness. We’ve even used the connect with a vet feature in a weekend semi-emergency, and they were also wonderful.

review_title: Exceptional Customer Service!
review_text: Chewy's customer service is truly exceptional!  Not only are they quick to refund or replace any items requiring attention but are also compassionate and caring toward their customers!  I recently contacted them regarding an issue with an order and referenced the recent loss of my beloved poodle.  A few days later, I received a beautiful memorial stone decorated with my sweet girl's name.  I was so deeply touched, i cried. They also sent me a get well gift as i had recently been discharged from the hospital and the kind representative noted how sick i had been during our phone conversation. Thank you for your kindness and incredibly thoughtful gestures!  You're hands down the best online company I've ever encountered!

review_title: Awesome customer service
review_text: Awesome customer service. It is my experience that chewy has the best customer service in the world. They truly care.

review_title: Our Epic Mainecoons of SWFL are big fan…
review_text: Our Epic Mainecoons of SWFL are big fan of Chewy and would like to share a few pics with you. Never had unresolved issue, always a great customer service.

review_title: Above and beyond…
review_text: I have never had an issue getting items and had multiple auto shop orders over the years. My 11 year old lab recently passed and the auto shop of food and supplements came days later. Contacted Chewy to see if I could return the items.  They told me to donate them to a local shelter and credited me within a day! Today I received a sympathy card and beautiful hand paints rock with my dogs name. Who does that?! Thank you Chewy for making things a little easier at a time when that is very needed!

review_title: I want to send a Thank you to Chewy
review_text: I want to send a Thank you to Chewy, Everything from delivery to customer service, they have always been the best. We received all our cat food and supplies from them for many years. Until our Senior cat crossed the rainbow bridge at the age of 21. After our cat passed and we had to cancel our orders they sent us flowers. I don't know of any other company that would be this thoughtful. Thank you again Chewy.

review_title: When customer service shows it's true heart
review_text: I meant to leave this review a while ago. I have shopped with Chewy for years, for my cats and dog. Last year I bought Organomics canned dog food as backup for my aging, raw-fed pup. Somehow I had autosubscribed, and under other circumstances I would have kept it and just cancelled future orders, but after some delay I called to return it and complain. Customer service is top rate, completely pro and polite always in my experience. But this time was different. To my grumpy, minimally communicating self, he asked why didn't want to keep it and I managed to say the words, "Because my dog died." And I knew he could hear me crying. His careful and kind words were an offering to my hard shell of grief. When flowers came in the mail, with a card from Chewy, I cried some more. It's been at least eight months since I lost him, but you know I can't write this without crying again. My grief is my own, I don't share it often. The voice on the phone, the flowers on my kitchen table, they were a gift to my broken heart. Thank you Chewy, and the man on the phone.

review_title: Chewy is good!
review_text: Chewy, as legends foretold, had incredible customer service. Since it's become available in Southern Ontario, I've made a handful of orders. They were all delivered really fast, like Amazon-level fast. And I've been sent a couple of gifts! They sent me a painting of my dog, a tag for him, and some birthday cards for my pets. So far, I'm pleasantly surprised with them as a company. They carry most of the pet supplies I need; though I wish they had a wider grooming tool selection.

review_title: I've been using chewy since 2019
review_text: I've been using chewy since 2019. My kitty had to be put down today. I had just received an order for about $200 including shipping. I asked if I could return it cuz it since it was unopened. They reimbursed me and told me to donate it. They didn't want me to have to deal with the return. Very generous and kind. Also, not once in 7 yrs did they mess an order up.

review_title: Surprised and touched
review_text: We have used chewy for many years for our dog and always extremely satisfied. Our pet passed away approximately a month ago and chewy,  out of the blue sent this beautiful hand painted rock with our babies’s name on it along with a lovely card, which was extremely unexpected and very much appreciated. It really touched our hearts and showed how much they care about their customers. You have no idea how much that meant to us. Thank you so much for the personal touch. I hope to be able to add a picture to show how special it really was.

review_title: 3 interactions in 2 months - ALL VERY GOOD
review_text: I have had 3 dealings in the last 2 months First and VERY IMPORTANT IMHO - a Human Being answers the phone quite quickly - Oh what a JOY! Second, I bought a compounded topical prescription cream that my vet provided the RX for.  Used it 3 days before my cat had an adverse reaction (Vet said, while not commonplace it is a known reaction in some cats) and recommended Diet instead of Drugs - when I bought the food at Chewy next and told the story they immediately refunded the cost of the Compound - that was NOT expected but exemplary of what great companies did in the past that almost none do today.  I am the first to loudly complain when companies behave badly - fairness requires that I make loud mention when I find a company behaving really well!

review_title: Simply the best
review_text: Chewy has always been wonderful to work with. When I used to have a subscription service, they would ALWAYS deliver on time. ONE time a package was damaged due to INCLEMENT weather and the delivery person, and they replaced it, no problem. I can recall at one point, my online account getting hacked by someone who is trying to purchase materials for their turtle in another state and I contacted chewy immediately. They were able to put a stop on it and make sure that the funds were back in my account. We reestablished a different account within a few minutes. We have lost pets before and received a card and flowers, expressing their grief at our loss. At that point we were told to donate the latest delivery to a shelter. This company is one of the best companies we have ever worked with! They are understanding and compassionate, and when you need to speak with someone, they truly appear to care. It is very rare to find a company like that nowadays. A+++

review_title: Cat waterer
review_text: Chewy always has anything you could possibly think of for your pet.  We selected a reasonably priced stainless steel cat waterer and it arrived in 2 days with a lifetime warranty!  Our cat loves it!

review_title: Chewy, the best company for Pet Supplies!
review_text: I have used Chewy to order my pet supplies for many years. Their app is easy to use and always putting my order together in hours of my request.  Packaging is done nicely and arrives quickly.  Also Chewy has the most awesome Customer Service to help with a problem when necessary, very courteous and knowledgeable.  Thanks Chewy!  "Meow"

review_title: Chewy has the best customer service…

review_title: A very thoughtful and kind company with great service
review_text: We have been customers of Chewy for years. As our cats aged, we need a prescription dry food (kidney health) and it was so much cheaper from Chewy than from the vet. We also need more specialized canned food and Chewy had that too. The convenience of having heavy cat food arrive at your door is also excellent.  However, we had to euthanize our cat Molly after sharing our lives with her for 21-1/2 years. It's been a much more difficult loss than we expected. We got a number of cards and very comforting messages from friends and the vet for which we are so appreciative. But, there was one special note of kindness I wanted to share. For the last few years, we had her wet food and prescription dry food regularly shipped to us from Chewy. A large box of canned food on subscription was shipped the day before we decided it was time to euthanize her. I contacted Chewy to see if they could recall the order but I was too late. The incrediby kind agent said not to worry. She refunded our account and told us to please donate the food to a local animal shelter rather than bother shipping it back. I thought that was just so generous. But then we got a surprise gift box in the mail today from Chewy. It had a personalized sympathy card and a  memorial stone handpainted with her name. We were both very touched by the card as well as the gift. We have decided to not have more cats or a dog at this point. But, if we ever do, I would definitely be buying from Chewy. I rarely write a fanboy post about a company, but this time I was so impressed I had to share my opinion about them.

review_text: I originally contacted Shopify because I wanted to report a scam. As a regular customer, it was very difficult to even find my way to customer support. While the support agent was polite, the process was extremely frustrating and highlighted major flaws in Shopify’s fraud handling: 1. Impossible reporting system: When a scam store is taken down, all links and confirmation URLs are gone. Shopify’s report form still requires these links, making it impossible to submit a claim even if you have proof like emails and screenshots. 2. No confirmation or accountability: Despite clear evidence of fake tracking, multiple fake email addresses, and a shut-down site, support could not confirm that it was fraud or provide any documentation I could use for a refund claim. 3. Platform is easily exploited: Scammers use Shopify’s professional storefronts and ads to look real, then vanish, leaving customers without any recourse. Suggestions: • Create a reporting form that doesn’t require a live store link. • Provide victims with written confirmation that a case has been filed and a store has been flagged or removed. • Improve fraud detection and pre-verification for sellers. I appreciate that support said they’d forward my case, but as it stands, this system makes it far too easy for scammers and too hard for customers to protect themselves

review_title: As an artisan who has sold on Etsy and…
review_text: As an artisan who has sold on Etsy and recently tried Shopify, I have to say that Shopify is challenging for those of us who want to focus more on creating than on marketing. I tried setting up my shop on Shopify, but it felt overwhelming and expensive. Unlike platforms like Etsy, Shopify left me on my own to drive traffic and manage every aspect of marketing. Shopify is great for businesses that want control and customization, but for individual artisans or small creators, it can be a lot to manage. Artisans generally want to focus on making quality products, not spending hours on marketing, SEO, and paid ads just to get a few sales. I think Shopify should consider creating a marketplace specifically for handmade items and unique creations, similar to how Etsy was in its early days. Such a platform could provide the customization options of Shopify but also help sellers by bringing in a built-in audience interested in artisan goods. This way, creators could concentrate on their craft without feeling burdened by all the business logistics. If you’re a creator or artist looking for a marketplace with built-in visibility, be aware that Shopify might not offer the same support as Etsy used to. While Shopify gives you control, it demands a lot more in terms of time, effort, and money to get noticed. I hope Shopify considers this feedback and maybe develops a platform to truly support artisans in the future.

review_title: Beware of Hidden Fees on Tips - Shopify's Greedy Grasp Extends Beyond Just Your Sales
review_text: As a small business owner utilizing Shopify to sell products and connect with my customers, I was initially pleased with the platform's ease of use and range of features. However, my satisfaction quickly turned to disbelief and frustration when I discovered how Shopify handles tips - an aspect of my business I believed was a straightforward token of customer appreciation. Shopify, why are you dipping your hands into the tip jar? It's understandable, albeit begrudgingly so, that transaction fees are applied to product sales. These are, after all, financial transactions requiring processing. But to extend this to include tips is both astonishing and deeply disappointing. Tips are a direct form of gratitude from my customers to my hard work and dedication, not another revenue stream for you to exploit. Upon receiving a €30 tip from a satisfied customer, I was shocked to see that Shopify had taken a cut. Upon inquiring, the explanation was that tips are subject to credit card fees since they're processed as part of the order total. This justification does not sit well with me. I am already paying a monthly subscription for the platform, in addition to the credit card fees for each transaction. To make matters worse, in the event of a refund, Shopify does not refund these fees. This policy feels like a penalty for providing great service that prompts customers to leave a tip. What company that respects itself and its clients operates in such a manner? This practice demonstrates a lack of understanding and appreciation for the hard work of merchants. It's disheartening to see a platform that's supposed to support small businesses instead find ways to further nickel and dime them, especially on something as personal and direct as a tip. To Shopify: I urge you to reconsider this policy. Respect the sanctity of the tip jar as a direct line of gratitude between customers and businesses. Do not tarnish it with unnecessary fees. Your platform has the potential to be a powerful tool for small businesses, but not at the cost of our values and the direct support from our customers. To fellow merchants: Be aware of this policy and consider how it affects your overall earnings and customer relationships. It's essential we demand better and hold platforms accountable for their policies and practices. In summary, while Shopify offers a robust platform for e-commerce, its handling of tips and fees leaves much to be desired. It's a reminder that the bottom line often comes before genuine support for small businesses. Shopify, it's time to re-evaluate your priorities and align your practices with the interests and well-being of the merchants who rely on you

And creating content isn't something you can really do on Shopify, in my experience. Unlike wordpress where everything you write is automatically saved, in Shopify, it isn't, and it's common to lose everything you've written. It's happened to me a few times, it's just happened (which prompted this review I clicked "save" after typing a full product description only to find that "save" in Shopify obviously means "Obliviate"... and the work was lost, no auto-save, nothing - I pressed "save" and it just lost everything. Shopify is just an ecommerce platform that has made it incredibly easy for anyone to open an ecommerce shop without having to waste time with all the backend hard work involved with setting up a store. Some of the biggest brands in the world use shopify for their merchandise stores (Redbull, New York Times, Budweiser, Lady gaga etc etc) obviously these are not scammers. So lesson here is exercise caution towards any ecommerce store on the internet, the hosting platform is irrelevant. So 90% of the reviewers here are channeling their anger at the wrong place. You might as well get mad at Sir Tim Berners-Lee for inventing the internet. For my own personal review of the platform itself. It's decent, definitely a big plus in the sense that it saves a tremendous amount of time towards setting up an eCommerce store. Wish they had much more free apps and plugins included for the monthly fee. review_text: How I would rate the entire Shopify experience is with a 1 but the excellent rate goes to one of the agents I was lucky enough get to look at my complaint and he fixed it, kept in touch until the very end of the resolution. I hope the company knows what they have and promote him. His name is Jef if anyone needs fantastic help.

review_title: I see a lot of poor reviews here..
review_text: I see a lot of poor reviews here... my question to these reviewers is this: If you don't like the platform for selling online, which would you recommend, and have you even tried using any others? To build an eCommerce store without any web dev experience, I don't think you'll find a better platform. Now, if you opt to hire a developer or spend time learning about all the ins and outs, you can do so much with Shopify. I could be wrong, but I have a feeling most of these negative reviews are coming from people who wanted to try to get rich overnight without any experience in running their own online store.
